original_test_intent: Screen every approved AMD PCIe target lane at four margin points using the exact amdxio parameters, prove complete per-lane CSV coverage and error limits, and confirm no downtrain while restoring every prior ASPM state.
original_method: Build a live immutable BDF/port/device/lane map, capture baseline speed/width/ASPM/AER, validate the exact amdxio version and optional fixture requirement, disable L1/L0s only on approved target links, run one full four-point test, preserve the complete CSV/raw output, verify per-lane row/parameter/error criteria and no downtrain, then restore and verify each original ASPM state.
manual_activity: The owner approves tool/fixture, live BDF/lane scope, parameter semantics, ASPM change and recovery; an operator monitors links and restoration; the owner decides the verdict from full CSV/fabric evidence.
required_inputs: SUT/BIOS/firmware/AMD device and PCIe topology identities
Compatible amdxio binary/version/checksum, driver/privilege requirements and any analyzer/fixture
Live BDF to physical port/device/OAM/lane-width map
Prior L1/L0s states and exact per-link restoration commands
Approved BER, ErrCnt, receiver, four-point phase/DAC range and output schema
Expected lane/row-count formula and duplicate/missing-row rules
Maintenance, console/recovery, thermal/power limits and explicit state-change approval
safety_requirements: Never copy example BDFs or derive scope only from vendor ID
Disable ASPM only on verified target links and record each prior state
Use the exact approved parameters and retain complete output/CSV
Do not clear baseline AER, dmesg, journal or SEL evidence
Continuously watch device presence, speed, width, errors, thermals and power
Restore every link's original ASPM state and verify it
Stop on downtrain, loss, excessive errors, malformed CSV, target mismatch or restore failure
No automatic rerun or broader ASPM disable
agent_execution_scope: Collect read-only inventory, BDF/lane map and baseline link/ASPM/error evidence
Validate supplied tool/schema/fixture and prepare exact scoped commands
Execute ASPM changes and margin run only after explicit approval
Parse every CSV row and verify all source criteria plus restoration
Perform no target/parameter selection, analyzer attachment, recovery decision, retry or DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve tool/fixture, live BDF/lane/OAM scope and parameter/output semantics
Approve ASPM disable, margin run, abort/recovery and exact restoration
Review row coverage, four ErrCnt/margin checks and no-downtrain evidence; issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source uses example BDFs and a sample 128-row formula without defining the live lane map, tool/fixture/version or ASPM restoration, and asks to clear logs. DeepSeek incorrectly converts the executable source into analyzer-only NO/manual scope.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The source provides an executable method; compatible tool, live mapping, optional fixture, approval and restoration are supplyable inputs. Execution becomes blocked only if a truly required dependency cannot be obtained.

review_improvement: Corrects the overly broad NO classification, preserves the full executable lane screen, makes CSV completeness and exact restoration mandatory, and prevents example BDF/row counts from being copied.
independent_technical_reasoning: The source command directly drives AMD link margining and produces lane-level results, so physical analyzer access is not automatically the sole execution path. However, a BDF identifies a live topology location and example values are unsafe to reuse. Disabling ASPM changes link policy, making per-link before/after state and recovery essential.
